statement: Let \(N = 1890 \times 1930 \times 1970\). Find the number of divisors of \(N\) which are not divisors of \(45\).

The function \(f(x,y)\) is defined for all reals \(x, y\), satisfies \(f(x,0) = ax\) (\(a \neq 0\)), and if \((c,d) \neq (h,k)\) with \(f(c,d) = f(h,k)\), then \(f\) is constant on the line through \((c,d)\) and \((h,k)\). Show that for any real \(b\), the set \(\{f(x,y)=b\}\) is a straight line and all such lines are parallel. Show that \(f(x,y) = ax + by\) for some constant \(b\).

\(AB\) and \(CD\) are perpendicular diameters of a circle. \(L\) is the tangent at \(A\). \(M\) is a variable point on minor arc \(AC\). Rays \(BM, DM\) meet \(L\) at \(P, Q\). Show \(AP \cdot AQ = AB \cdot PQ\). Construct \(M\) so that \(BQ \parallel DP\). If \(OP\) and \(BQ\) meet at \(N\), find the locus of \(N\). Lines \(BP, BQ\) meet the tangent at \(D\) at \(P', Q'\) — find the relation between \(P'\) and \(Q'\). Lines \(DP, DQ\) meet \(BC\) at \(P'', Q''\) — find the relation between \(P''\) and \(Q''\).

A plane \(p\) passes through a vertex of a cube so that the three edges at that vertex make equal angles with \(p\). Find the cosine of this angle. Find the positions of the feet of perpendiculars from the vertices onto \(p\). Among the 28 lines through two vertices and the 20 planes through three vertices of the cube, find some relationship with \(p\).
